summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology with hands-on experience building and deploying machine learning models across NLP, computer vision, and speech domains. Proficient in Python, PyTorch, and TensorFlow — background spans dataset processing pipelines, model development, and AI application deployment across 7 internships.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT (OCR-free visual document understanding transformer) on a custom dataset for text extraction using PyTorch.
Built end-to-end preprocessing and training pipelines to standardize dataset preparation and model evaluation workflows.
Improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% through iterative model tuning and data preprocessing improvements.

experience.title: Research Fellow
bullets: Built a dataset pipeline for BraTS 2020 multi-modal MRI data with augmentation and batch-loading; trained U-Net with VGG-16/19 and ResNet-50 backbones, evaluated on Dice Score and IoU.
Led a 7-person cross-cultural team as sole ML-experienced member; restructured task distribution to deliver the full pipeline within a 6-week window.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Developed a Python GUI (PyQt + Matplotlib) for real-time laboratory data acquisition and experimental visualization.
Maintained collaborative data analysis workflows using GitLab version control and JupyterHub.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced model memory footprint by ~25% via structured pruning and 8-bit quantization on TinyLlama 1.1B; evaluated across HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC benchmarks.
Assessed accuracy-efficiency trade-offs (~7% accuracy drop, +6.3 perplexity increase) to characterize deployment feasibility for resource-constrained environments.

projects.name: COFFIN – Whisper-Style ASR from Scratch
bullets: Built an end-to-end ASR pipeline in PyTorch: 80-channel mel spectrogram encoder, 6-block Transformer decoder with cross-attention, trained on 1,000 Indian-English samples achieving training loss ~0.51.
Designed a custom BPE tokenizer with Cython-accelerated backend achieving 4–5.5× speedup; achieved 15% WER on Hindi-English dataset.

awards: 1st Prize, Poster Presentation — 2D and 3D Image Mosaicing of Microscopic Images, F.C.R.I.T. (2024)
Ranked 10th, Robocon — National-level robotics competition among 45 universities (2022)
